principle: Improve research quality over time by learning better discovery scope, source choice, freshness sensitivity, and handoff quality without making every mission research-heavy.
guardrails: research should remain purposeful and proportionate
do not turn every mission into a browsing-heavy workflow
prefer authoritative and useful sources over source volume
use freshness sensitivity where it matters, not everywhere
rule: Use mission outcomes to improve research quality and handoff without encouraging unnecessary research sprawl.
